Lesson 5 — Everyday actions to Lesson 8 — Thinking and…

This lesson teaches 105 Thai words for lesson 5 — everyday actions to lesson 8 — thinking and feeling in the Beginner part of the course, starting with ทำ (to do), วันนี้ (today), ดู (to see), ดี (good). Each word is shown in Thai script with tone colours, romanization and its English meaning, and you can hear it spoken at normal and slow speed.

Go through the cards at your own pace, then take the quiz to check what stuck. When you are ready, practise the same words in 278 example sentences.

Practise them in example sentences →
